sky.comment: primary: logo, headings, CTAs, icon fills

deep.comment: hover for anything blue; secondary headings

ice.comment: page / card tint; table header alt fill

ink.comment: body text, dark sidebar - never pure black

skyDeep.comment: alias of deep — used by Shell/Field

amber.comment: brand amber — attention emphasis (pair with status semantics, never as success/error)

slate.comment: muted text / faint metadata on light surfaces

clay.comment: Direction D secondary warmth accent - eyebrows / section accents, ~5%, brand only, never status

200.comment: default border on cards, inputs, table rows (Direction D warm-sand)

400.comment: text grey - stays neutral (Direction D warms surfaces only)
